data.name: SingFever - Your Sing Game
data.detailed_description:
SingFever: The Ultimate Party Singing Game!

Step into the spotlight and let your voice shine with SingFever, the ultimate karaoke experience for friends, families, and aspiring superstars! Inspired by the legendary singing games like SingStarTM, and similar Sing Games, SingFever takes the fun to the next level with an extensive song library, dynamic gameplay modes, and engaging features designed to make every performance unforgettable.

Key Features:

🎵 Massive Song Library: Sing along to hundreds of songs across genres—pop, rock, classics, and the hottest hits of today. New tracks are added regularly to keep your playlist fresh!

Sing Forever with over 26000 Songs use them from Ultrastar like USDB 

🎤 Dynamic Gameplay Modes: From solo challenges to duet duels, team battles, and party playlists, there's something for every kind of singer.

🌟 Interactive Performance Scoring: Real-time pitch detection and feedback ensure fair competition while rewarding creativity with bonus points for style and flair.

🎧 Studio-Quality Audio: Enjoy crystal-clear backing tracks and high-fidelity sound for a professional karaoke feel.

✨ Customization & Personalization: Unlock fun effects, avatars, and stage environments to make your performances uniquely yours.

📱 Mobile Integration: Use your smartphone as a mic or access a companion app to queue up songs and track your scores.

💃 Party Mode Extravaganza: Perfect for gatherings! Set up playlists, use themed challenges, to keep the crowd entertained.

🌐 Online Leaderboards & Challenges: Compete with players around the globe and prove you're the ultimate SingFever champion.

Whether you're belting out power ballads, rapping to the latest hits, or harmonizing with friends, SingFever makes every moment a stage-worthy celebration. Warm up those vocal cords and get ready to experience karaoke like never before—SingFever is where the party starts and never ends!

Featuring a massive song library, dynamic gameplay modes, and real-time scoring. Grab the mic, hit the notes, and let the fever take over! 🎤🎶 Sing Forever = Sing over 26000 Songs
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+), Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: 2.8 GHz, two cores, 64-bit architecture | AVX and AVX2 (for speech recognition only)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 capable
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
